header.name: Export Tags
header.description: Writes each part's layer and pen into its name before a glTF export (for the PYTHA glTF Importer in Blender), and removes them again.

extension.caption: Tag parts for export
extension.description: Append {L<layer>:<layer name> P<pen>} to every part name. Export glTF, then run Remove export tags.

extension.caption: Remove export tags
extension.description: Remove the {L.. P..} tags from every part name.
